cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A teaches the pupil to count the cost of its delay by keeping a visible chronology until B offers acknowledgment.
confusable: The goal is relief through apology, not reimbursement or simply proving punctuality matters.
comparison: Immediate physical intrusion versus paper reconstruction of an evening.
seedUse: Use D27 keys/buses/receipt/refused cash, with S05 claims of taught accounting or consideration grading B response.
